title: Great little vacuum for small jobs, price is a bit high.
text:
Great little vacuum for small jobs, price is a bit high.. Update: The more I use it the more I love it. I still don't like the way it empties but it is a powerful little vacuum so I will up it to 4 stars.

This is a nice little vacuum for quick clean up. It has a spinning brush or you can press the button to have it not spin. It vacuums well and is easy to empty but more hands on than other vacuums. You have to remove the handheld vac, open it, remove the filter and the inside cone to completely empty. It's not a push button like a Dyson or Rowenta cordless vacuum. With the Dyson and Rowenta, you just remove dirt cups from the vacuum, push a button and the dirt empties from the bottom.

I'm not sure how long the filter will last. It appears to be a paper filter.

I love that it is rechargeable. I haven't timed how long it stays charged yet. Will do that soon. It's not hard to connect to recharge but the Dyson is much easier. You just slip it into the wall mounted bracket and it recharges. With the B&D, you have to plug it in before you hang it onto the wall mount. Not a huge deal but worth mentioning.

The reason for only 3 stars is the price. My opinion is, this is just a handheld vacuum on a stick with a brush. Not worth over $100. I would go with the Rowenta or the Dyson for power and convenience. If the price would be lower, I would only give 4 stars due to the emptying process.
